messages:
maria.k: deploy-bot flagged image promotion for service 'router' stuck in quarantine at canary stage :warning: looks like registry digest mismatch. anyone on call?

deploy-bot: [automated] promotion-id=prom-2026-03-21-03 canary=5/5 status=quarantined reason=manifest_digest_mismatch registry=eu.gcr.io/redwood-inference

ben.t: @maria.k ping — saw this alert. quick check: `kubectl get pods -n router-canary` shows 2/3 ready, one CrashLoopBackOff.

olivia: CrashLoop logs show `failed to pull image: manifest unknown` and `denied: requested access to the resource is denied` — sounds like a digest didn't replicate to the EU registry.

maria.k: ok. two questions: 1) do we pin this release or roll back the canary to previous image? 2) do we block global promotion until registry fix? change window ends in 40m.

ryan.s: I'd prefer to hold promotion globally. If digest isn't present in eu registry, promoting will create partial traffic splits and errors. Suggest manual hold, create a blocker in release notes, and run a selective rollback for the canary pods.

ben.t: agree. we can patch the canary ReplicaSet to previous digest: `kubectl -n router-canary set image deploy/router router=eu.gcr.io/redwood/router@sha256:<old>` then watch.

olivia: We should also pin the Helm chart values for image.tag to the working digest so future 자동 promotions don't re-trigger until replication confirmed. Add an override in the canary values:

```
image:
  repository: eu.gcr.io/redwood/router
  tag: "sha256:<old>"
```

maria.k: I'll open a manual hold now and add to release notes. @deploy-bot can you mark promotion as held and notify ops?

deploy-bot: promotion prom-2026-03-21-03 marked HELD by @maria.k. Notifying on-call and pausing cross-region promotion.

ben.t: I pushed the rollback pod-spec change to the canary via `kubectl set image` — pods are restarting. `kubectl rollout status deploy/router -n router-canary` shows success.

olivia: can we also bump the canary canaryRetention to 0 to avoid traffic leak while we validate? (we usually keep 10% but with missing images I'd prefer 0).

ryan.s: do that in the canary routing config: `kubectl apply -f canary-routing.yaml` — I can run it if you want.

maria.k: go ahead @ryan.s. I'll add a short note in the release channel and tag infra to check registry replication.

ryan.s: applied routing patch, canary traffic now 0%. validated with `curl` to canary header — no traffic forwarded.

olivia: infra update: EU registry replication lag confirmed, fix in progress. ETA ~25m.

maria.k: plan: 1) hold global promotion until replication confirmed, 2) pin Helm values for chart version/image in canary and update release notes with blocker, 3) once replication done, run a promote job and monitor 5m, then unhold if green. Any objections? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:

ben.t: :thumbsup:

olivia: :thumbsup: also add a rollback playbook snippet to release notes (kubectl set image + helm pin example).

deploy-bot: noted. Created ticket INFRA-4721 and attached promotion hold. Will re-run promote job on manual resume.

maria.k: thanks everyone — I'll finalize the release notes and close the loop once infra marks replication complete.

ryan.s: thanks — I'll keep an eye on canary pods for 30m.

olivia: filing short postmortem entry to capture registry replication test in preflight checklist.

maria.k: closing thread for now, will update here when replication done. :eyes:
